python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QSize
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
anchor = fluentqt.Button("New shortcuts", %PARENT%)
anchor.setFixedSize(136, 32)
anchor.move(152, 129)
anchor.show()
control = fluentqt.TeachingTip(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.setTarget(anchor)
control.setLightDismissConsumesPress(True)
control.setCardSize(QSize(268, 96))
layout = QVBoxLayout(control.contentHost())
layout.setContentsMargins(14, 10, 14, 10)
layout.setSpacing(4)
header = QHBoxLayout()
header.setSpacing(8)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Command palette", control.contentHost())
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
header.addWidget(heading, 1)
close_button = fluentqt.Button(control.contentHost())
close_button.setAccessibleName("Close tip")
close_button.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.ChromeClose)
close_button.setFluentLayout(fluentqt.Button.ButtonLayout.IconOnly)
close_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Subtle)
close_button.setFixedSize(24, 24)
header.addWidget(close_button)
layout.addLayout(header)
body = fluentqt.Label("Press Ctrl+K anywhere to jump to files or commands.", control.contentHost())
body.setWordWrap(True)
body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(body)
close_button.clicked.connect(control.close)
anchor.clicked.connect(control.open)
control.open()
